claims.sentence: Interestingly, it has been suggested that while senescent cells can take months to develop, only 30 % of senescent cells need to be eliminated to see benefits in preclinical studies, as such a short-term hit and run approach to senolytic therapy may have the potential to improve tissue function in the long-term, while reducing detrimental side effects clinically ( Hickson et al., 2019 ).
